package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	svc "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

func TestOnboardingMaterializationForwardsExactLessonRevision(t *testing.T) {
	const studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	const admission = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	const course = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	const lesson = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	const revision = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	const key = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var body struct {
			Lessons []struct {
				LessonID   string `json:"lesson_id"`
				RevisionID string `json:"lesson_revision_id"`
			} `json:"lessons"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if len(body.Lessons) != 1 || body.Lessons[0].LessonID != lesson || body.Lessons[0].RevisionID != revision {
			t.Errorf("lost exact revision: %#v", body)
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(materializationResponse{Schema: admissionResultSchema, AdmissionID: admission, Status: "MATERIALIZED", CourseID: course, AssignmentID: key, LearningPathID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", FirstLessonID: lesson, LearningPathVersion: 1, JourneyVersion: 1})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "write", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.MaterializeOnboardingPathExecution(context.Background(), svc.OnboardingPathMaterialization{StudentID: studentID, AdmissionID: admission, IdempotencyKey: key, CourseID: course, Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: lesson, LessonRevisionID: revision}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
